case.title: Shadows over the Sunset
case.introduction: A glamorous charity gala is held at the secluded Villa Aurora. Amidst the clinking glasses and soft jazz, a priceless painting disappears and the host, philanthropist Elias Monroe, is found dead in the garden. Everyone present has something to hide.
case.crime: Murder of Elias Monroe and theft of the famed painting "Aurora's Dawn" during the gala.
case.escape_plan: A hidden dock on the lake leads to a speedboat pre‑loaded with the stolen painting; the boat departs at 9:30 PM under the cover of darkness.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Rows of leather‑bound books, a fireplace, and a large desk where speeches are drafted.

rooms.name: Balcony
rooms.description: Overlooks the garden and lake, decorated with lanterns, the spot where the toast is delivered.

rooms.name: West Wing
rooms.description: Contains guest rooms and a quiet hallway often used for private conversations.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.description: A secluded office filled with art catalogs, a safe, and a mahogany desk.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: Bustling with chefs, aromatic dishes, and a pantry where supplies are stored.

rooms.name: Helipad
rooms.description: A small concrete pad beside the villa, where a private helicopter is parked.

characters.name: Lena Hart
characters.background: Introduced as a longtime friend of the Monroe family, actually Victor Kline, a notorious black‑market art smuggler.
characters.secret: True identity is Victor Kline; hired to steal "Aurora's Dawn" for a private collector.
characters.goal: Obtain the painting and escape via the lake speedboat.
characters.alibi: Was in the Library preparing the evening’s speeches and reviewing donor lists.

relationships.detail: Grew up with the Monroes; trusted by Elias.

knowledge: Exact time the security guard changes shift
lies: She never left the Library before the murder.

characters.name: Elias Monroe
characters.background: Owner of the Villa, known for lavish charity events; secretly deep in gambling debt.
characters.secret: Owed a large sum to a loan shark; planning to sell the painting to cover it.
characters.goal: Secure a $5 million donation for his new arts foundation.
characters.alibi: Was on the Balcony delivering the toast at 8:45 PM.

relationships.detail: Had a secret romance with Sofia.
Commissioned Dr. Patel to authenticate the painting.

lies: He never trusted the security chief.

characters.name: Sofia Delgado
characters.background: Former police officer hired to oversee security for the gala.
characters.secret: Had an affair with Elias; fears scandal would ruin her career.
characters.goal: Maintain order and protect her reputation.
characters.alibi: Patrolling the West Wing from 8:30 PM to 9:10 PM.
knowledge: The security code for the Study safe.
lies: She never accessed the Study that night.

characters.name: Dr. Arun Patel
characters.background: Renowned art historian who recently authenticated "Aurora's Dawn" for the Monroe collection.
characters.secret: Forged parts of the painting to increase its value.
characters.alibi: In the Study reviewing the inventory list at 9:00 PM.
knowledge: The exact location of the hidden ledger.
lies: He never left the Study after 9:05 PM.

characters.name: Mia Chen
characters.personality: Eager, nervous, eager to prove herself
characters.background: Recently hired to help with event logistics; stole a keycard earlier to explore the villa.
characters.secret: Used the stolen keycard to sneak into the Study and hide a small box.
characters.goal: Earn a promotion by impressing the staff.
characters.alibi: In the Kitchen coordinating appetizers from 8:15 PM to 9:00 PM.

relationships.detail: Lena taught her about donor etiquette.

knowledge: Where the hidden box is concealed in the Study.

characters.name: Jasper Lee
characters.background: Hired to stand by the helicopter for a possible emergency evacuation.
characters.secret: Was paid by Victor to secure a quick exit route via the lake.
characters.goal: Complete the job and get paid.
characters.alibi: At the Helipad checking the helicopter’s fuel at 8:50 PM.
knowledge: Exact launch time of the speedboat.
lies: He left the Helipad before 9:20 PM.

timeline.description: Guests begin to arrive; music starts in the Library.
Sofia patrols the West Wing; Mia prepares appetizers in the Kitchen.
Elias delivers a heartfelt toast on the Balcony; crowd applauds.
Dr. Patel reviews the inventory in the Study; Lena (c1) checks the ledger on the desk.
A scream erupts from the Garden; guests rush to the scene.
Elias Monroe is found dead, a wound to the chest; the painting is missing.
Police secure the scene; guests are questioned in the Library and Study.
Speedboat departs from the hidden dock, leaving no trace.

evidence.name: Blood‑stained leather glove
evidence.description: A left‑hand glove with a distinctive tattoo of a black phoenix on the cuff, soaked in blood.

evidence.name: Hidden ledger
evidence.description: A small leather ledger listing art smuggling transactions, dates, and buyer names, tucked inside the Study desk drawer.

evidence.name: Broken vase fragment with fingerprint
evidence.description: Shards of a porcelain vase from the Balcony, bearing a clear fingerprint matching Victor Kline's records.

evidence.name: Forgery certificate
evidence.description: A certificate claiming the painting is an original, signed by Dr. Patel; analysis shows forged ink.

evidence.name: Love letter
evidence.description: A handwritten love letter addressed to Elias, found in the West Wing desk, signed "S."

evidence.name: Keycard log
evidence.description: Electronic log showing the stolen keycard used to access the Study at 8:55 PM.

hidden_clues: A torn page of a shipping manifest with the coordinates of a remote dock.
A scrap of sailcloth matching the speedboat’s hull found in the Library’s waste bin.
red_herrings: The forged certificate points suspicion to Dr. Patel.
The love letter suggests Sofia had a motive to silence Elias.

solution.reasoning: The blood‑stained glove with Victor’s phoenix tattoo, the hidden ledger listing his smuggling deals, and the fingerprint on the broken vase all directly link Lena Hart to the murder and theft. These pieces contradict her alibi of staying in the Library. While evidence such as the forged certificate and love letter create plausible alternatives, they are proven red herrings. Victor used the speedboat escape coordinated with Jasper, and the hidden clues (shipping manifest and sailcloth) confirm the planned getaway.

state.current_objective: Identify the hidden target among the suspects.
